Group rides in Florida

18 recurring group rides around Florida: 10 road, 8 social, 2 cruiser. 5 roll on weeknights, 8 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Bike Pensacola Slow Ride in Pensacola — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? South Broward Wheelers Saturday Ride runs 15–17 / 17–19 / 19–21 mph groups.
